gate.notStaff: This console is for platform staff.
gate.impersonating: You're signed in as a member of an organization. Stop to come back to the console.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.empty: No organizations yet. Onboard the first one.

health.heading: System health
health.allWorking: Everything is working. Super admins get an email if something breaks.
health.since: Since {when}, reported {count, plural, one {once} other {# times}}.

aiUnavailable.title: The AI isn't answering
aiUnavailable.meaning: No AI model answered: the provider may be down or its key wrong. The AI answers no customer meanwhile.

aiRateLimited.title: The AI's limit is used up
aiRateLimited.meaning: Every AI model and key said its limit is used up. It answers again when the limit resets; billing or a backup key ends the wait.

jobsFailed.title: Background jobs are failing
jobsFailed.meaning: Jobs used all their retries and stopped: emails, PDFs, imports or WhatsApp sends among them.

apiErrors.title: The api is hitting errors
apiErrors.meaning: Requests ended in errors nothing handled. The server's log has their names and codes.

workerStalled.title: The worker isn't taking jobs
workerStalled.meaning: The worker didn't answer the console's ping. Follow-ups, WhatsApp replies, the AI and emails wait until it runs again.
